Macquarie's infrastructure-adjacent private-equity strategy controls the company through MSOF Beacon, UniSuper publicly discloses an approximately 30% co-investment and Partners Capital is a named co-investor. afterImage.description: Potters Industries, LLC manufactures glass beads, microspheres and engineered materials used in road and airfield markings and specialized industrial applications. The company is headquartered in Malvern, Pennsylvania and operates a broad manufacturing and logistics network across North America and Europe, with additional presence in South America and Asia. A Macquarie Asset Management-led consortium acquired control in December 2025 through the Macquarie Strategic Opportunities Fund infrastructure-adjacent private-equity strategy. UniSuper publicly discloses an approximately 30% interest and Partners Capital is a named co-investor; the remaining consortium split is not publicly disclosed.
